# Onboarding plan — SMDurgan, LLC (`smd`)

**Generated by:** `aie-onboard` skill (2026-05-31), from the **real** onboarding interview
(`operator/customers/smd/onboarding-interview-2026-05-31.md`) — replacing the prior
fixture-derived plan.
**Status:** buildable subset approved (triage + draft-only). Not provisioned, not committed by the skill.
**Persona:** Crane (Chief of Staff). **Vertical:** mixed.

Crane is an internal "eat our own cooking" deployment (ADR 0004 / #776). v1 scope is the part
the substrate can actually honor today: read the principal's Gmail and produce categorized
triage with draft replies for review. **Crane does not send in v1** — see Blocker B1.

## Phase 1 — Discovery + Access + Data audit (Day 1–5)

| Action                                                                                                                                 | Owner              | Gating prerequisite                                              | Output artifact                             |
| -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| Provision `hermes-smd` Machine (`provision-customer.sh smd`)                                                                           | Captain            | customer.yaml approved; Fly auth + R2 + category-1 secrets ready | Running Machine in `needs-keys` state       |
| Gmail OAuth consent for **intake inbox `smdurgan@smdurgan.com`** (`mcp:google-gmail`, `gmail.modify` — read/label/archive, never send) | Customer (Scott)   | Machine provisioned                                              | `/opt/data/oauth/google.json`               |
| Google Calendar OAuth consent (`mcp:google-calendar`)                                                                                  | Customer (Scott)   | Same Google consent                                              | Calendar scope on `google.json`             |
| Google Drive OAuth consent (`mcp:google-drive`)                                                                                        | Customer (Scott)   | Same Google consent                                              | Drive scope on `google.json`                |
| **Voice-sample collection — SOURCE TBD** (no samples supplied at interview; interim seed = Scott's prose in working sessions)          | Customer (Scott)   | Principal supplies a writing-sample source                       | Samples at `r2://vaults/smd/voice/samples/` |
| Scope/data audit — confirm `email_folders_visible: [Inbox]` is the intended triage envelope                                            | Captain + Customer | OAuth complete                                                   | Confirmed `scope.*` envelope                |

> **Open item:** No writing samples were supplied. Voice calibration cannot run until the
> principal provides a source; `voice_profile_id: scott` falls back to the general profile
> until then. Do not fabricate a voice. (Extraction-contract open-item.)

## Phase 2 — Shadow mode: observe / draft / no-send (Day 6–14)

| Action                                                                    | Owner            | Gating prerequisite | Output artifact               |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------- | ------------------- | ----------------------------- |
| Enable `inbox-triage` @ `draft_for_review` (drafts only, never sends)     | System           | Gmail OAuth live    | Triage drafts in review queue |
| Hourly cron fires 0700–1900 Phoenix (`0 7-19 * * *`, wake_policy: always) | System           | Skill enabled       | Hourly triage runs            |
| Review of triage drafts; Captain tunes / grades                           | Customer (Scott) | Skill enabled       | Edit feedback / grading notes |

## Phase 3 — Graduated autonomy (Day 15+)

No promotion candidates in v1. `inbox-triage` stays `draft_for_review` — the principal
explicitly wants to send replies himself ("never auto-send as Scott").
Promotion is not on the table until a send transport exists (B1) and the principal chooses to raise it.

## Open items & blockers

- **B1 — 🔴 No outbound send transport (architecture decision required).** The interview wants Crane
  to send its own mail and report to `team@smd.services`. Gmail is `modify`-scope (structurally
  never-send, `crane_gmail.py`) and AgentMail is unwired (deferred Phase 2 per `provision-customer.sh`).
  The "Crane sends" half of the interview is unbuildable until a transport is chosen: wire an AgentMail
  identity, add a `gmail.send` scope for Crane's own box, or formally defer. Tracked as #1165.
- **B2 — 🟠 Tiered model is a schema gap.** Interview: routine `claude-sonnet-4-6`, sensitive
  `claude-opus-4-8`. `model:` is a single string; set to the sensitive default. Per-task tiering needs
  a schema/overlay change (relates to #1100).
- **B3 — ✅ `inbox-triage` frontmatter bugs (#1140) — FIXED in this change.** Renamed
  `smd-inbox-triage` → `inbox-triage` (name now matches dir) and `trust_ceiling: draft_only` →
  `draft_for_review` (valid enum). Closes #1140.
- **B4 — 🟡 No voice samples.** `voice_profile_id: scott` declares intent; real samples are an open item.
- **B5 — 🟡 Crane's own identity address.** Schema convention is `crane@smd.agents.smd.services`, NOT the
  interview doc's invented `crane@agentmail.to`. Unprovisioned until B1 is resolved.
- **B6 — 🟡 Trusted-sender allowlist.** Interview: obey direction only from `smdurgan.com` / `smd.services`.
  Not expressible in the current schema; interview marks it "not v1."
- **B7 — 🟡 `vertical: mixed`.** The enum has no consulting/services value (#1141).
